title: BP / sugar ki dawai *har mahine* chahiye. Aap yaad dilate ho?
fix_label: Dawai khatam hone se 3 din pehle 👇
message:
Namaste [naam] ji, aapki [dawai ka naam] lagbhag *[date]* tak khatam hogi.
Kya same quantity ghar bhej dein? "YES" reply karein.
[Delivery free / time]
why: khatam hone se pehle = *aap pehli dukaan* ho jo yaad dilaye. "YES" = order.
caption:
Chronic patients (BP, sugar, thyroid) har mahine dawai lete hain. Jo dukaan pehle yaad dilati hai, order wahi jaata hai. 💊

Kaise:
1️⃣ Bill pe quantity + date note karo
2️⃣ Khatam hone se 3 din pehle message
3️⃣ "YES" = home delivery

Ek register se shuru karo, baad mein automatic. Save karo 🔖
